name: GA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: The district's D+27 lean, Johnson's incumbency, and his clear fundraising edge over an underfunded challenger all point to a lopsided Democratic hold, and markets agree at roughly 97% for the Democrat. No polling or expert ratings contradict this picture.
model.watch: A major polling surprise or unexpected outside spending against Johnson would be the main thing to move this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Georgia's 4th District is a heavily Democratic Atlanta-area seat, with a partisan lean of about D+27. Hank Johnson, the longtime incumbent, is running for re-election and holds a large financial advantage, having raised over $400,000 while Republican James Duffie reports little visible fundraising. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%, consistent with the district's strong partisan tilt. With an entrenched incumbent, a deep funding gap, and no evidence of a competitive environment, this race is rated Safe D, with the main uncertainty limited to turnout-driven variation in the final margin.
